propositions: gitutil.run_git_write does not retry write-side loose-object temp-file creation faults (unable to create temporary file / failed to insert into database / unable to index file) because _with_transient_head_retry only matches READ-side markers

event_append._git_add retries the same write-side faults via a private _TRANSIENT_ADD_MARKERS definition, while s3_doctor and other run_git_write callers lack retry protection, creating asymmetric fault handling

write-side marker family (_TRANSIENT_WRITE_MARKERS: unable to create temporary file, failed to insert into database, unable to index file) must be moved to gitutil as the single definition so all run_git_write callers inherit bounded 3-attempt retry
corrupt-object signatures (loose object ... is corrupt, inflate: data stream error) and index.lock faults are excluded from the retry classifier and must surface immediately
nested retry composition in event_append (3x3 attempts on HEAD + ADD retries) should collapse to single bounded retry (3 attempts) after de-duplication
